page_title: BAR 3-2 ALM | Barcelona v Almeria 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was!
90+2' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
90+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+1' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

87' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner, but Inaki Pena pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
85' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
83' 3 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski plays a pass to the feet of Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 3:2.
82' Lazaro (Almeria) is caught offside!
78' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
77' Gaizka Garitano prepares a substitution. Leo Baptistao is replaced by Lazaro (Almeria).
77' Substitution. Adrian Embarba (Almeria) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Largie Ramazani walks off.
77' Flag up against Alejandro Balde (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
76' Xavi has decided to substitute Raphinha and he is replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
75' The attendance for today's match is 34471.
74' A cross is whipped in towards Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
74' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
74' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.
71' 2 - 2 Goal! 2:2. The ball rebounds to Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
70' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 10:0.
67' Substitution. Fermin Lopez is replaced by Oriol Romeu (Barcelona).
67' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
66' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
66' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Houboulang Mendes (Almeria) replaces Alejandro Pozo.
63' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

63' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but Luis Maximiano pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
60' 2 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
60' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
60' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Dion Lopy (Almeria) for his blatant foul.
55' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
54' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
54' Corner kick. Raphinha (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
53' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Luis Maximiano.
53' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
51' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
50' Raphinha (Barcelona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
50' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.

49' What an amazing save by Luis Maximiano! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.

49' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Luis Maximiano, who tips the ball around the post.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) comes off for Jules Kounde.
46' Xavi has made a change at the break. Ferran Torres has come on in place of Joao Felix (Barcelona).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
45+1' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Referee Guillermo Cuadra points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Almeria players celebrate.
42' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Guillermo Cuadra is going to take a look using VAR.
41' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Leo Baptistao (Almeria) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
39' Joao Felix (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
37' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Luis Maximiano leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
36' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
33' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
33' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) will take a corner kick.
33' The ball is cleared after Raphinha (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Barcelona get a corner.
32' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
29' The Almeria players are exchanging some short passes.
25' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) comes to nothing.
25' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
24' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
21' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
19' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:2.
15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Raphinha (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
14' Raphinha (Barcelona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
13' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
12' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
11' It's a nice effort by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Luis Maximiano. Easy save.
9' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

8' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' Raphinha (Barcelona) prepares to take a corner kick.
8' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Joao Felix (Barcelona) inside the box. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
6' Joao Felix (Barcelona) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
5' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
4' The referee blows his whistle as Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) was too aggressive in his challenge.
2' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
